title: Travelers' Health | CDC
content: CDC is currently responding to the outbreak of Andes virus, a type of hantavirus, among passengers and crew of a cruise ship which had been sailing in the Atlantic Ocean. The overall risk to the American public and travelers for Andes virus infection is extremely low. Routine travel can continue as normal. Learn more: Andes Virus Outbreak on a Cruise Ship: Frequently Asked Questions . Cruise ship travel While cruising is a popular way to travel, there are some health concerns to be aware of. Find out more about health issues on cruises and steps you can take to stay safe and healthy during your trip.
